title: Use temporary credentials with AWS resources

observations.note: Read page text via fetch (no raw digest). States a call with temporary credentials must include the session token returned with them; the CLI example sets AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN together; API requests carry the session token in a header or query parameter X-Amz-Security-Token. Does not state whether the session token alone is confidential.
